title: Alibi and Portrait
author: Oscar Iversen
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
